# Autoliv receives Automotive News PACE Pilot recognition for the innovation Omni Safety™


Wed, Nov 18, 2026 08:00 CET[Report this content](https://news.cision.com/_editorial/Contact?url=https%3a%2f%2fnews.cision.com%2fautoliv%2fr%2fautoliv-receives-automotive-news-pace-pilot-recognition-for-the-innovation-omni-safety-%2cc4425969)


***(Stockholm, Sweden, November 18, 2026)* – Autoliv, Inc. (NYSE: ALV and SSE: ALIVsdb), has received recognition in the 2026 Automotive News PACE Pilot program for Omni Safety™ an innovative mobility safety solution.**


**The Automotive News PACE Pilot program recognizes innovations from suppliers that have reached a working pilot demonstration stage but have not yet been commercialized through a contracted sale.**


**“Receiving PACE Pilot recognition is a great acknowledgment of the innovation and expertise of our teams,” said Fabien Dumont, Executive Vice President & Chief Technology Officer of Autoliv . “As mobility evolves, we continue to develop safety solutions that address new vehicle designs and future mobility scenarios. Our Omni Safety solution demonstrates how we combine our deep knowledge of automotive safety with advanced technologies to support our vision of Saving More Lives.”**


**Omni Safety™ represents Autoliv’s system-level approach to occupant protection. The solution includes seatbelt, airbags, and pin puller, which are integrated with the seat and vehicle interfaces into one seat-centric system designed to better protect occupants in reclined seating positions. It reduces downward sliding and the risk of injuries to the head, neck, pelvis, and lumbar spine, while maintaining comfort.**


**The recognition reflects extensive collaboration across Autoliv’s product development, engineering, customer, innovation, and business teams. It also highlights Autoliv’s ability to combine deep safety expertise with solutions addressing emerging trends in vehicle design, automated driving, and occupant protection.**


**In 2025, Autoliv received Automotive News PACE Pilot recognition for the Bernoulli™ Airbag Module.**

*About Autoliv*


*Autoliv, Inc. (NYSE: ALV; Nasdaq Stockholm: ALIV.sdb) is the worldwide leader in automotive safety systems. Through our group companies, we develop, manufacture and market protective systems, such as airbags, seatbelts, and steering wheels for all major automotive manufacturers in the world, as well as mobility safety solutions, such as commercial vehicles and electrical safety solutions. At Autoliv, we challenge and re-define the standards of mobility safety to sustainably deliver leading solutions. In 2025, our products saved approximately 40,000 lives and reduced around 600,000 injuries.*


*We have operations in 25 countries, and we drive innovation, research, and development at our 13 technical centers. Our 64,000 employees are passionate about our vision of Saving More Lives and quality is at the heart of everything we do. Sales in 2025 amounted to $10.8 billion. For more information go to*[www.autoliv.com](http://www.autoliv.com/) *.*
